decision.reason: Fine-tuned ViT improves its own pretrained baseline, but temporal attention and learned scorer fail to beat the frozen M10 representation. Shadow learned-scorer reconnects also regress. No independent identity accuracy or valid broadcast camera-uncertainty supervision established. Keep M9 serving, preserve M10 research baseline.

dataset.expansion_result: All ten official MOT clips audited. No additional disjoint match/team identities beyond frozen training anchors can be asserted without weakening M10 leakage controls. Full-half videos do not by themselves supply audited paired box identity labels. Keep 51; more identities unavailable under these constraints.
dataset.sequence_selection: 8–12 observations, temporal bins and quality/scale/brightness/contrast/phash diversity; true pose/orientation unknown
dataset.geometry: existing supplied per-match nonlinear pitch-keypoint interpolation; proxy position, not independent ground truth; uncertainty remains unknown

selection.test_policy: No retraining/reselection after this lock; all TEST comparisons final. M10 TEST historically published.
